data.name: MIRROR_MODE_TEXT
data.value:
This modifier allows you to toggle the "Mirrored" mode during gameplay.
NOTE: Enabling this setting will enforce it in the current and subsequent levels. To stop that, disable the setting in the ModMenu.

data.name: RESET_DELAY_TEXT
data.value: This modifier changes how long it takes until Mrs. Pomp will target the player again.

data.name: MAX_HALLTIME_TITLE
data.value: Max. halltime

data.name: OVERRIDE_VERTEX_GLITCHING_TITLE
data.value: Override vertex glitching

data.name: MAX_HEIGHT_TITLE
data.value: Max. height

data.name: MIN_STAY_TIME_TEXT
data.value: The maximum stay time modifier manipulates the minimum amount of time for Cloudy Copter to blow air.

data.name: GLITCH_INTENSITY_TEXT
data.value: The glitch intensity modifier manipulates how far the individual verticies move, with every MIDI event.

data.name: VECTOR2_CORRUPTION_TEXT
data.value: The Vector2 corruption modifier slightly shifts a Vector2's values (x and y) during construction. THIS MODIFIER CAN RENDER YOUR GAME SESSION UNUSABLE! USE AT YOUR OWN DISCRETION!

data.name: MIDI_LOOP_TITLE
data.value: Loop

data.name: SWEEP_MOVEMENT_MULTIPLIER_TEXT
data.value: The sweep movement multiplier modifier manipulates how fast an entity can move freely, while riding Gotta Sweep.

data.name: BALLOON_COUNT_TITLE
data.value: Balloon count

data.name: LIGHTS_OUT_TEXT
data.value:
This modifier allows you to toggle the "Lights Out" mode during gameplay.
NOTE: Enabling this setting will enforce it in the current and subsequent levels. To stop that, disable the setting in the ModMenu.

data.name: COLLECT_NOTEBOOKS_TEXT
data.value: This option allows you add a specific amount of notebooks to your current total. This will not collect any of the existing notebooks on the current floor, they can still be collected to add to the current total. NOTE: This option is influenced by the YCTP Behaviour modifier.

data.name: MAX_HEIGHT_TEXT
data.value: This modifier adjusts how far the water rises, when the flood event starts.

data.name: PLAYER_HEIGHT_TEXT
data.value: The height modifier allows you to control how high or low the player camera should be.

data.name: TAPE_ANTI_HEARING_TIME_TITLE
data.value: Anti hearing time

data.name: ENVIRONMENT_TIMESCALE_TITLE
data.value: Environment timescale

data.name: VIDEO_DIARRHEA_MIN_COOLDOWN_TITLE
data.value: Min. cooldown

data.name: SUPER_HOT_TEXT
data.value: The SUPER HOT modifier makes it so time moves, when you move.

data.name: MIN_TIME_ACTIVE_TITLE
data.value: Min. time active

data.name: GUM_STUCK_TIME_TEXT
data.value: This modifier adjusts how long a character gets affected by Beans' gum, when hit by it.

data.name: ENTITY_GPS_TEXT
data.value: The entity GPS modifier allows you to see the locations of all existing characters through the walls, by showing their names below them.

data.name: SPAWN_TEXT
data.value: The spawn modifier allows you to create a specific amount of new instances of the selected character at the player's current position. The spawned instances will always be inactive by default, until the player is far enough away from the spawned character. The distance the player needs can be controlled in the Settings by changing the Character Activation Distance option.

data.name: GUM_MOVEMENT_MULTIPLIER_TITLE
data.value: Gum movement multiplier

data.name: WD_NOSQUEE_TIMER_TEXT
data.value: The timer modifier allows you to control how long the area around the player stays silenced after using WD-NoSquee.

data.name: WD_NOSQUEE_SILENCE_RADIUS_TITLE
data.value: Silence radius

data.name: WD_NOSQUEE_SILENCE_RADIUS_TEXT
data.value: The silence radius modifier allows you to control how many tiles around the player get silenced by WD-NoSquee.

data.name: LANGUAGE_TEXT
data.value: Auto picks Russian when the CyrillicPlus mod is installed and English otherwise.

data.name: HL1_MOVEMENT_TITLE
data.value: HL1 Movement

data.name: HL1_MOVEMENT_TEXT
data.value: Half-Life 1 (WON) movement: bunnyhopping without a speed cap, autojump while the left mouse button is held, ducking, picking up items, small furniture and decorations with the pick up key, and a yes clip through walls with something in the hands. Unlocks the camera and replaces the staminometer with a speedometer.

data.name: GOD_MODE_TITLE
data.value: God Mode

data.name: GOD_MODE_TEXT
data.value: Baldi can't catch you (the game's own invincibility flag), and neither can the lethal touch of Classic, Yet Again. He doesn't take your apple either.

data.name: YTP_TEXT
data.value: Your YTP. Setting it doesn't count towards the floor's total and isn't multiplied.

data.name: LIVES_TEXT
data.value: Lives left in this run.

data.name: GRADE_TEXT
data.value: The grade the game gives you, from A+ to F-.

data.name: NPC_MAP_ARROWS_TITLE
data.value: Show characters on the map

data.name: NPC_MAP_ARROWS_TEXT
data.value: Arrows for every character on the map, like the Stealthy challenge shows the Principal: Baldi in green, the others in red.

data.name: REVEAL_MAP_TEXT
data.value: Fills in every tile of the map, like the map from Johnny's shop.

data.name: OPEN_LOCKED_ROOMS_TEXT
data.value: Removes the padlocks of the locked rooms, as if you'd used the keys.

data.name: OPEN_ALL_EXITS_TEXT
data.value: Every elevator opens for leaving and none is out of order. The notebooks don't count as collected.

data.name: FINISH_FLOOR_TEXT
data.value: Ends the floor as if you'd taken an elevator. Not on the last floor of the story.

data.name: USE_FIXED_SEED_TITLE
data.value: Scene manager uses this seed

data.name: USE_FIXED_SEED_TEXT
data.value: Floors loaded from the scene manager are built from the seed below instead of a random one, so the same seed gives the same school.

data.name: FIXED_SEED_TITLE
data.value: Seed

data.name: FIXED_SEED_TEXT
data.value: The seed for the scene manager and for the button below. The game builds floor N from seed + N.

data.name: CURRENT_SEED_TEXT
data.value: The seed of this run, as the elevator screen shows it. Click to copy it into the field above.

data.name: APPLY_SEED_TO_NEXT_FLOORS_TEXT
data.value: Sets the run's seed to the one above. This floor stays as it is; the next ones are built from the new seed.

data.name: REFLEX_COOLDOWN_TITLE
data.value: Cooldown

data.name: REFLEX_COOLDOWN_TEXT
data.value: Seconds after a test before Dr. Reflex can test you again.

data.name: REFLEX_REWARD_TITLE
data.value: Reward

data.name: REFLEX_REWARD_TEXT
data.value: YTP a test starts with; every miss takes the penalty off.

data.name: REFLEX_PENALTY_TITLE
data.value: Penalty per miss

data.name: REFLEX_PENALTY_TEXT
data.value: YTP taken off the reward for every miss or slow answer.

data.name: THE_TEST_FOG_TIME_TITLE
data.value: Blindness time

data.name: THE_TEST_FOG_TIME_TEXT
data.value: Seconds the fog lasts after The Test blinds you.

data.name: THE_TEST_EXPLODE_CHANCE_TITLE
data.value: Explode chance

data.name: THE_TEST_EXPLODE_CHANCE_TEXT
data.value: Chance (0 to 1) that The Test blows up instead of blinding you.

data.name: THE_TEST_FLEE_SPEED_TITLE
data.value: Flee speed

data.name: THE_TEST_FLEE_SPEED_TEXT
data.value: How fast The Test runs away once it has blinded you.

data.name: LOCKDOWN_MIN_DOORS_TITLE
data.value: Min. doors

data.name: LOCKDOWN_MIN_DOORS_TEXT
data.value: The fewest lockdown doors the event puts in the hallways (0–50).

data.name: LOCKDOWN_MAX_DOORS_TITLE
data.value: Max. doors

data.name: LOCKDOWN_MAX_DOORS_TEXT
data.value: The most lockdown doors the event puts in the hallways. A floor with few hallways gets fewer.

data.name: MYSTERY_ROOM_START_TEXT
data.value: Opens the mystery room again. The room is built with the floor, so this works only on a floor that was generated with one.

data.name: TIME_OUT_ANGER_RATE_TITLE
data.value: Anger interval

data.name: TIME_OUT_ANGER_RATE_TEXT
data.value: How often, in seconds, Baldi gets angrier while the school is closed.

data.name: TIME_OUT_ANGER_AMOUNT_TITLE
data.value: Anger added

data.name: TIME_OUT_ANGER_AMOUNT_TEXT
data.value: How much anger Baldi gets each time.

data.name: TIME_OUT_LIGHT_RATE_TITLE
data.value: Lights interval

data.name: TIME_OUT_LIGHT_RATE_TEXT
data.value: How often, in seconds, one more hallway light dims.

data.name: TIME_OUT_START_TEXT
data.value: Closes the school now: Baldi keeps getting angrier and the lights go out. The game has no way to end it; it lasts until the floor ends.

data.name: BALDER_SPAWN_RATE_TITLE
data.value: Spawn interval

data.name: BALDER_SPAWN_RATE_TEXT
data.value: How often, in seconds, a balder comes out of each spawner room.

data.name: STUDENT_TOTAL_FOLLOWERS_TITLE
data.value: Students

data.name: STUDENT_TOTAL_FOLLOWERS_TEXT
data.value: How many students follow the leader of the crowd (0–512).

data.name: STUDENT_PUSH_SPEED_TITLE
data.value: Push speed

data.name: STUDENT_PUSH_SPEED_TEXT
data.value: How hard the crowd pushes the player and the characters it runs into.

data.name: STICKER_SLOT_TEXT
data.value: The sticker in this slot. Stickers that change the floor's generation (more items, a bigger map) take effect from the next floor.

data.name: STICKER_GLUE_TEXT
data.value: A glued slot keeps its sticker from floor to floor, as with the Glue Stick.

data.name: STICKER_ADD_TEXT
data.value: Puts the chosen sticker into the sticker book; apply it from there in the Pitstop.

data.name: GRAVITY_GUN_DESC
data.value: Gravity Gun Use: lift the furniture in front of you (lockers, desks, tables) or throw what you hold. E puts it down, the mouse wheel held down turns it. It isn't used up.

data.name: USE_ITEMS_ANYWHERE_TITLE
data.value: Use items anywhere

data.name: USE_ITEMS_ANYWHERE_TEXT
data.value: Items can be used where the game forbids them: in the Pitstop and Johnny's store, out of bounds.

data.name: GRAVITY_GUN_ON_MAP_TITLE
data.value: Gravity gun on the map

data.name: GRAVITY_GUN_ON_MAP_TEXT
data.value: Every new floor has a Gravity Gun among its items. Use it to lift any furniture (lockers, desks, tables) and again to throw it; the pick up key (E) puts it down, and holding the mouse wheel and moving the mouse turns it. Activities, notebooks, doors and elevators stay in place.

data.name: GIVE_GRAVITY_GUN_TEXT
data.value: Puts a Gravity Gun into the inventory.

data.name: SOLVE_ALL_ACTIVITIES_TEXT
data.value: Every math machine, balloon buster and match on the floor is solved right, as if by the player: points, Baldi's pause, the notebooks appear.

data.name: FREE_STORE_TITLE
data.value: Free store

data.name: FREE_STORE_TEXT
data.value: A 100% sale on everything in Johnny's store: items, sticker packs, the map, the glue stick and the restock cost 0 YTP.

data.name: MINIGAME_AUTO_WIN_TITLE
data.value: Auto-win minigames

data.name: MINIGAME_AUTO_WIN_TEXT
data.value: A field trip minigame (Campfire Frenzy, Picnic Panic) is won perfectly as soon as its title is over: the perfect bonus, the win screen and the trip's items. Replays from the high score table are played as usual.

data.name: FAST_ELEVATOR_TITLE
data.value: Fast elevator

data.name: FAST_ELEVATOR_TEXT
data.value: The elevator between floors runs eight times faster: the zoom, the doors, the results board and the waits before the next floor.
